title: Student V0.1 JOB 06 — real showcase kit
purpose: Produce one source-traceable 30–45 minute canonical learnit.kit.v4 showcase journey for later pilot qualification, using existing canonical Nombres complexes material as the bounded content source.
invariants: The V4 contract and authoring validators are read-only authorities.
The existing canonical Nombres complexes Atlas kit is content evidence, not permission to invent unsupported mathematics.
The showcase is a new V4 candidate, not an automatic in-place migration of V2 identities.
Source fidelity outranks activity variety and quality diagnostics.
A qcm/fill-only result is not sufficient to demonstrate Student V0.1 richness; genuinely distinct cognitive operations must be represented when supported by the source.
Media must be local, pedagogically justified and fail closed.
requiredEvidence: Explicit learner brief for a 30–45 minute journey.
External provenance map from every new V4 learning unit to the canonical source material it derives from.
Pedagogical-quality report at least STRONG; EXCELLENT_BY_PROFILE preferred without source distortion.
Evidence that chosen activity families correspond to distinct cognitive operations rather than variety quota.
At least one meaningful non-scored learning unit and meaningful evaluated interactions beyond only qcm/fill, unless the source honestly prevents that—in which case HOLD.
Embedded media safety and alt/pedagogicalRole checks if media is used.
Factory context generation bound to exact source/brief/kit hashes.
No fabricated claim of independent semantic review; status must be explicit.
adversarialTests: Adding a family solely to increase variety is a quality failure.
Any new mathematical fact/example not supported by the chosen canonical source basis is a source-fidelity failure.
A lesson-heavy or assessment-only journey is a quality HOLD.
A classify task that is disguised matching, an order task with non-meaningful order, or constructed free text with unbounded semantics is a HOLD.
Reusing V2 identity semantics without explicit V4 authority is forbidden; use fresh V4 identities when continuity is not normatively defined.
A semantic-review PASS may be claimed only with independently bound evidence.
independentReview: The worker must challenge whether Nombres complexes is sufficient for a truthful rich V4 journey before authoring.
The worker must preserve provenance outside the kit rather than inventing new contract fields.
The final candidate must remain useful as real learning content, not a feature demo.
rollback: Close the JOB06 PR and delete its branch; no product code or sibling branch is changed.
